top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a sharp prediction (Kane and Mele: spin-orbit-driven time-reversal-protected insulator with a Z2 invariant and edge channels) with a decisive measurement (Molenkamp: quantised edge conductance in HgTe wells), confirmed independently for about two decades in transport and ARPES. The citation can be drawn narrowly around the two-dimensional quantum spin Hall state, which fits the three names; the omission of Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang is a real attribution cost but does not outweigh the maturity and clarity of the achievement. Optical lattice clocks (P002) come second but overlap the 2005 and 2012 prizes; trapped-ion computing (P003) overlaps the 2012 trapped-ion work and has a weaker experimental split; P004 has the least clean credit.
